back: Ferments sugar to ethanol and CO₂: CO₂ raises bread; ethanol in beer.
Ferment milk sugar to lactic acid, making sour milk (amasi) and yoghurt.
Fixes nitrogen in legume root nodules (groundnuts, soya beans), reducing fertiliser needs.
Protoctist that causes malaria; vector: female Anopheles mosquito.
Protoctist that causes sleeping sickness in people and nagana in cattle; vector: tsetse fly.

Mould on damp stored groundnuts and maize that can produce liver-damaging aflatoxins.

front: Importance of animals to Zimbabwe's economy
back: Tourism, food (cattle, kapenta, mopane worms), leather, regulated hunting, pollination; also pests and vectors.
